provider.name: The Eye Surgery Center
provider.affiliatedPractice: New England Vision and Vermont Eye Laser

catalogStatus.finding: No public full procedure-price catalogue or machine-readable price file was found on the provider's official public website.
catalogStatus.limitation: This records public material available without a login on the official domain on the check date. It does not prove that no private, unlinked, patient-specific, or payer-specific price list exists.

methods: Parsed every content entry in the four official page, post, category, and tag sitemaps.
Followed same-domain links and reviewed every page whose URL or text matched price, pricing, cost, fee, charge, transparency, chargemaster, machine-readable, CPT, cash, commercial, or Medicare terms.
Downloaded and text-searched all PDF files linked from the current Patient Forms and Advanced-Technology Implants pages.
Searched the official domain for price-catalog and machine-readable-file terms.

surfacesChecked.result: The page says a patient receives an individual price after a screening. It publishes no numeric base price or procedure catalogue.
The page describes third-party financing and a $200 purchase threshold. The threshold is not a procedure price, and the page contains no catalogue.
The page advertises $1,000 off LASIK or financing from $99 per month. It does not publish the underlying procedure price or a catalogue.
The page makes comparative cost claims but publishes no procedure amounts or catalogue.
The current forms page links 14 public PDFs across patient forms, cataract materials, and lens brochures. None is a full procedure-price catalogue.
The current office policy states one $50 refraction charge when insurance denies coverage. This isolated office fee is not a procedure-price catalogue.
